== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Timer Mine (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — A timer bomb set by a mine-laying droid. It was developed to blast ore veins and spice mines, but it has been converted for military use.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where your mine-laying droid is. It “explodes” on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many of the opponent's characters there are immediately lost (the enemy chooses who). At that time the Timer Mine is also lost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is タイマー地雷. Explodes on your next turn, not “at beginning of your next turn”. Uses 位置カード and 即座にロスト. Choice is 敵. The mine is also lost, with no Lost Pile wording.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-timermine.gif|Original English face]], [[Timer Mine (Dark)]].</ref>
